intent.logline_zh: 乡野空地上，挎花篮的农家妇女以花海凝成的木剑群击退潮水般的骑士冲锋。

characters.desc_zh: 中年农家妇女模样，粗布衣衫，手挎编织花篮，全程不说话

beats.what_zh: 骑士群压境冲锋，妇女站定高举花篮
繁花自篮中涌出铺满原野，马匹在花海边缘扬蹄
花海已凝成木剑群攒射，前排落马，残部溃退

audio.music_zh: 史诗管弦：战鼓加高亢弦乐，随施法渐强、随溃退渐弱

risks: “数百名”已改写为潮水般：H3 画不出精确大数字
花变剑的变形过程未直拍：Shot2 收在花海已成，Shot3 开在木剑已成，跨切完成形态转换（aftermath 模式）
用户已确认：单段12秒、史诗配乐、花篮持物

pe.integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action open countryside at dusk. A tide of armored knights on horseback thunders across the field toward a lone middle-aged peasant woman in a coarse tunic, a woven flower basket on her arm. The camera holds a static wide shot as she plants her feet and lifts the basket high. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts closer and shakes slightly as countless blossoms burst from the basket and blanket the field in a rolling sea of flowers, horses rearing at its edge. [Shot 3] At 00:08.500, the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the sea of flowers has become a volley of wooden swords sweeping the front rank from their saddles, the survivors fleeing past the woman standing firm amid settling petals.
pe.overall_soundscape: Thundering hooves, a floral rush swelling into whistling sword volleys and clashing steel, then petals settling in the wind.
pe.non_diegetic_music: Epic orchestral score with war drums and soaring strings, swelling as the spell breaks and receding as the knights flee.
